title: Chapter 275 All Back
content:
Chapter 275 All Back

Hearing Lu Xue's praise, Qin Feng's smile became even worse.

But Xiao Luo, who was standing beside him, was jealous and itchy.

Damn, I knew I had just gotten on my way.

At this time, Xu Zijing said, "Since this competition has ended, Zijing will take his leave first."

Then Xu Zijing bowed, "Goodbye, everyone."

Looking at Xu Zijing who was leaving, Qin Feng raised his hand and wanted to say something, but he still didn't speak.

The other people bragged to Qin Feng a few words, and then left here.

"Brother Qin, did you want to say something just now?"

Xiao Luo looked at Qin Feng and asked.

Hearing this, Qin Feng looked at the direction of Xu Zijing leaving, and said calmly, "How do you think Xu Zijing's strength?"

"Xu Zijing?"

Xiao Luo was slightly stunned. He was not very famous for Xu Zijing in the entire Tiandi Academy.

Of course, his main fame all comes from the lower class.

For example, those academy experts know very little about Xu Zijing.

Because Xu Zijing is famous for his knowledge.

The name Brother Dong is not groundless.

But for Xu Zijing's strength.

Xiao Luo pondered for a moment and shook his head slightly.

"have no idea."

Seeing this, Qin Feng smiled and then looked at Lu Xue, "Sister Xue, how strong do you think Xu Zijing is?"

Lu Xue looked at the direction where Xu Zijing left and said, "He has been suppressing his strength. I don't know how strong he is, but he must be stronger than you."

Suppress strength!

Hearing this, Xiao Luo looked shocked.

Is this kid hiding so deeply?

Qin Feng's face was a little embarrassed. He said Xu Zijing, "Why do you compare with him?"

"Sister Xue, why did he suppress his strength?"

Xiao Luo was a little confused.

Lu Xue curled her lips and said, "How could I know, go and ask him yourself."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo scratched his head.

At this time, two figures suddenly appeared beside several people.

"Ahem."

Jordan Yang coughed a few times.

The few people immediately noticed Jordanyang and Tan Songci who suddenly appeared beside them.

"Student, I have met two mentors."

Lu Xue and his friends saluted Jordanyang and the others.

Jordanyang looked at the people and then smiled and said, "You guys, their strength has improved a lot over the years."

As he said that, Jordanyang looked at Ao Qing on Lu Xue's arm intentionally or unintentionally.

Hearing this, Qin Feng smiled and said, "Thanks to the training of the academy, if there were no Tiandi Academy, how could the students be today?"

Hearing this, Jordanyang and Tan Songci laughed.

"You boy, you really know how to say it, no wonder your master likes you so much."

"Qin Feng."

At this time, Tan Songci spoke.

"Teacher Tan."

I saw an exquisite ring appearing in Tan Songci's hand and handed it to Qin Feng.

"This is the reward for you to defeat that broken sword boy, the academy will give you."

After taking the ring, Qin Feng's expression suddenly lit up.

"Thank you!"

But then, Tan Songci's expression changed and he said seriously: "Next, my academy will not be so calm anymore."

Feeling the change in emotions, the people present also looked solemn.

Tan Songci continued: "It's like the young man who broke the sword just now, named Dao Qing, who was the descendant of the Immortal Emperor of Break Sword several times ago."

"There are countless such people in the entire fairy world now. My Tiandi Academy has a large number of geniuses and monsters. It must be the main goal of those who have just been born and want to show their strength."

When several people heard this, they immediately looked solemn.

"Mr. Tan, what do you mean is that in the future, more and more people will come to the academy to challenge like you did just now?"

Tan Songci nodded slightly.

"And, it will get stronger and stronger."

Hearing this, Qin Feng also frowned.

If this happens, the pressure on me will be a bit too great.

As if he felt Qin Feng’s thoughts, Xiao Luo smiled and said, “Brother Qin, don’t panic, I’m still there, we can’t do it, Sister Xue and Brother Qing.”

Lu Xue nodded, "If there is trouble in the academy, I will definitely not sit idly by."

Since she has entered this Tiandi Academy, she will do what the academy students should do.

"My little master, there are only those cats and dogs. You don't need to take action yourself. Just let me do it, and I can kill them myself!"

Ao Qing said with her teeth and claws.

If it weren't for Xiao Luo and Qin Feng just now, he would have gone up to beat the kid with the knife.

"Okay."

At this time, Jordanyang couldn't stand it and interrupted them.

"You are the only ones who have made this huge Tiandi Academy."

Jordanyang's mouth twitched slightly, "Did you forget what our Tiandi Academy is called, the gathering place for monsters in the world!"

"What our Tiandi Academy lacks the most is genius and monsters."

Tan Songci nodded on the side and said, "No, now, it's time to get those guys back."

Those guys!

Those terrifying monsters who stand on the list of monsters and look down on the heroes.

Each one is a pseudo-invincible existence in one field.

Unless something big happens, those guys will basically not practice step by step in the academy.

Flowers in greenhouses will never achieve anything.

Lu Xue and the others looked at each other and immediately understood something.

Qin Feng was one of the few people who had been in Tiandi Academy for the longest time, so he knew very well how important those guys were in the Academy.

It can be said that those guys are the future pillars of Tiandi Academy.

They are coming back.

Jordanyang and Tan Songci looked up slightly, looking at the void, with heavy eyes.

Buzz —

A subtle tremor sounded from the depths of the academy.

The next moment, everyone felt a sense of traction coming from the academy token.

Lu Xue and his friends took out the academy token and looked at the slightly trembling token.

at the same time.

Among the ruins in some place in the fairyland.

The evil ghosts roared, hundreds of ghosts and monsters were flying continuously in the ruins, looking extremely infiltrating.

What’s scary is that every ghost here has the aura of the Immortal Saint Realm.

And in the middle of these ghosts, a figure with a strong yin energy suddenly opened its eyes.

The dark blue eyes look bright and energetic.

After a moment of silence, he took out a slightly trembling token and immediately showed a miserable smile.

"Is there any trouble with the academy?"

"Jiehahahaha, I haven't returned to the academy for a long time, and the academy has been so depressed."

He kept mocking the academy, but he still stood up slowly, his legs full of holes looked very ferocious.

In this way, he walked slowly outside with a staggering pace.

In that direction, it is Tiandi Academy!

.........

On the other side, the other end of the fairyland.

boom!

The blast sounded constantly, and a man with a reflective head and muscles on his body were in the center of dozens of stone statues, constantly waving his fists.

Every time he swung his fist, a stone statue would roar.

But at this moment, the man suddenly stopped and let the surrounding stone statues smash towards him.
